source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cleaning and transformation (PDF 133).

blocks.text: Kachcha data aksar ghaltiyan, ghayab qeematein ya ghalat shakal rakhta hai. Data cleaning aur transformation analysis se pehle yeh masail theek karte hain ta ke nataij durust hon.

blocks.prompt: Analysis se pehle data saaf karna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Ghair durust ghaltiyan, khala aur dohrai nataij ko gumrah kun banati hain.

items: Kachcha data analysis se pehle saaf aur tabdeel karein.
